"tag": "prose", "text": "Il fit encore une pause, puis il recommença :", "sha256": "7db3b1629c8e901fcb13c1dce951529c74e654de907b20dcf89099ff22ca7967", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0033", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Qui est-ce donc qui t’a envoyée à cette heure chercher de l’eau dans le bois ?", "sha256": "63f4fdc81044157b48975afdadf22a90f52eef2a356cc82d495d8f4c17076371", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0034", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est madame Thénardier.", "sha256": "70bc8e8f3f5f5330b458df5ecdaae8a731f71577f9d9eff87ab2992b38e7cdd5", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0035", "tag": "prose", "text": "L’homme repartit d’un son de voix qu’il voulait s’efforcer de rendre indifférent, mais où il y avait pourtant un tremblement singulier :", "sha256": "71c42086dfa21c4a0c6831d5c6094f01d1a702f5a5203912fb913bf7e0bc61d3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0036", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Qu’est-ce qu’elle fait ta madame Thénardier ?", "sha256": "ad9266217e10800313ac67d931a1bdb5c79155e00666d3c9d6eff99f15ed695c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0037", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est ma bourgeoise, dit l’enfant. Elle tient l’auberge.", "sha256": "04a67907fd8df69b23c646a9b8e56fbe60baea4bf7df63450c1ea3dc0880a9e1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0038", "tag": "prose", "text": "— L’auberge ? dit l’homme. Eh bien, je vais aller y loger cette nuit. Conduis-moi.", "sha256": "11fb6dbb51852718bbce160ff0a8b427506c26f386007203196511fa5122a427", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0039", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Nous y allons, dit l’enfant.", "sha256": "7335b4e270df6a318b669c34b75ebdcc4f8c08ba1acb6904d5cceec553da4084", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0040", "tag": "prose", "text": "L’homme marchait assez vite. Cosette le suivait sans peine. Elle ne sentait plus la fatigue. De temps en temps, elle levait les yeux vers cet homme avec une sorte de tranquillité et d’abandon inexprimable. Jamais on ne lui avait appris à se tourner vers la providence et à prier. Cependant elle sentait en elle quelque chose qui ressemblait à de l’espérance et à de la joie et qui s’en allait vers le ciel.", "sha256": "ced684804592f9c5d3b9dd37eb87e680001bfece40661181659dbc8d71edf8db", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0041", "tag": "prose", "text": "Quelques minutes s’écoulèrent. L’homme reprit :", "sha256": "7534ca5690a60ff1dae6c0f6d7a87252ab6ad2f72abacfbcd3868c00f2560272", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0042", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Est-ce qu’il n’y a pas de servante chez madame Thénardier ?", "sha256": "b33ad60aa943dc16fada956867c43f99979297c3e016ab940fd2987ce24723b7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0043", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Non, monsieur.", "sha256": "17ae79b5fe3ff4a7c72562c7e47cad81a393b024ec4f88955f17157b2af5f187", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0044", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Est-ce que tu es seule ?", "sha256": "7a95ebad0138396979b41d61292facff2993de4985a89c05756ff593ad9ac8b4", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0045", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oui, monsieur.", "sha256": "0d5465ec58ffd8a169046d0b5a9216b597e575402307c2d51b58ce3a1f4a288b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0046", "tag": "prose", "text": "Il y eut encore une interruption. Cosette éleva la voix :", "sha256": "39ee23bdace6fcdff93708863b5d9000aeb46bf789706a3a4a3eeba3d9defc04", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0047", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est-à-dire il y a deux petites filles.", "sha256": "f627bc51d0b8273b5839df7acdf5f64dda7fc4ae0b6e3234d530b232aa70f552", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0048", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Quelles petites filles ?", "sha256": "17d615bf2be7149af5985a75455f554f43ede4425ddb61d81a30a0ae33e7ab86", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0049", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ponine et Zelma.", "sha256": "4029fdad2739de792273de40daa57d19cbd9c840146af95705a38ac3a7d2a7f9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0050", "tag": "prose", "text": "L’enfant simplifiait de la sorte les noms romanesques chers à la Thénardier.", "sha256": "512362342592bbbc13d30e846b66b4f8b22f041d55567ce33977aa5d58ec812f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0051", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Qu’est-ce que Ponine et Zelma ?", "sha256": "e8f0a1da3dd4010139f4421b84aaf9c860d9ce0ef2731821968dfba7263fa3d6", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0052", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ce sont les demoiselles de madame Thénardier. Comme qui dirait ses filles.", "sha256": "266a91dbf574406548d3287aefd9087920c140689e246818ac731bb7a211090f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0053", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Et que font-elles, celles-là ?", "sha256": "56e06c1087f9bda8f69501f92d2fcceb8ed1f63ee974c033613426cf70712e9b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0054", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oh ! dit l’enfant, elles ont de belles poupées, des choses où il y a de l’or, tout plein d’affaires. Elles jouent, elles s’amusent.", "sha256": "bff86549baec55ac83410d3f35ca4a6452c3dccdf31635644d1bbcdaf62ba3ca", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0055", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Toute la journée ?", "sha256": "9ed9a0f4dfd8a873bebbf2ae78da4a000976e595eba3168a2bbd8104d29a4042", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0056", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oui, monsieur.", "sha256": "0d5465ec58ffd8a169046d0b5a9216b597e575402307c2d51b58ce3a1f4a288b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0057", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Et toi ?", "sha256": "f85507006c5f81ab8ce779049df8a3cb43fa2ce982bb39b1e84f459cc782e19c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0058", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Moi, je travaille.", "sha256": "86f00e998b270e67d506c772f5dfb6a041bd36d88ad486d90b6e4ee5537652ce", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0059", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Toute la journée ?", "sha256": "9ed9a0f4dfd8a873bebbf2ae78da4a000976e595eba3168a2bbd8104d29a4042", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0060", "tag": "prose", "text": "L’enfant leva ses grands yeux où il y avait une larme qu’on ne voyait pas à cause de la nuit, et répondit doucement :", "sha256": "47b465ad5676885e137ad6fb87fddcafdb2106c2e99079636933770d22c06bf0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0061", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oui, monsieur.", "sha256": "0d5465ec58ffd8a169046d0b5a9216b597e575402307c2d51b58ce3a1f4a288b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0062", "tag": "prose", "text": "Elle poursuivit après un intervalle de silence :", "sha256": "9bddfa0e422dff7ec0932712da2a7270f538050c31f97c95d8511eb8e07ef632", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0063", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Des fois, quand j’ai fini l’ouvrage et qu’on veut bien, je m’amuse aussi.", "sha256": "4f748e69af8b45c665e7645685a8f6f688c48e6ca8b0300d4ceb8a99009daa9b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
